sentences.text: On a charter, your biggest stability variable is people.
When someone hooks a big fish, everyone wants to rush to one rail, and on a small boat that can be enough to capsize or swamp it.
Keep passengers spread out and seated when running, and keep heavy loads like coolers and ice low and centered.
Respect the capacity plate on small boats.
Remember that loading changes during the day: you burn fuel, melt ice, and fill the fish box.
And water trapped on deck acts just like free surface.
